title: Suprême C 100% Vitamin C Brightening Serum

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, vitaminC, crueltyFree, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, fragranceFree

descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Fragrance Free✓ Good for: Uneven Texture✓ Good for: Dark spots✓ Vitamin C
What it is: An ultra-concentrated vitamin C gel-oil serum that visibly boosts brightness and fades dark spots in as few as two weeks.

Skin Type: Normal, Dry, and Combination

Skincare Concerns: Dark Spots, Fine Lines and Wrinkles, and Dullness

Formulation: Lightweight Serum

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Tetrahexyldecyl Ascorbate: Visibly brightens and fades dark spots and hyperpigmentation while firming and smoothing the look of lines.

Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This single-ingredient serum features 100 percent THD ascorbate, a potent yet gentle vitamin C derivative. It has a springy gel-oil texture that absorb
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Apply one to two pumps to cleansed skin morning and/or night, before your moisturizer (a little goes a long way).
-Wait until fully absorbed before applying makeup or coming into direct contact with fabric or sheets.
-If using in combination with Skin Activator (sold separately), apply Skin Activator first.
Ingredients+
-Tetrahexyldecyl Ascorbate: Visibly brightens and fades dark spots and hyperpigmentation while firming and smoothing the look of lines.

Tetrahexyldecyl Ascorbate.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
